note: What was read by eye, 2026-11-21. 'lidar_objects' only says what a group of LiDAR returns is (the position and the height come from the LiDAR); 'photo_objects' are things only the aerial photo shows; 'statue_faces', 'buildings' and 'faces' are read from ground photos; 'markings' are digitised from the aerial photo. Aerial photos: Orthofoto 2026 of the City of Bern (WMS Geoportal/Orthofoto_2026, flown March/April 2026, 10 cm, trees bare; positions read to about 0.3 m) and swisstopo SWISSIMAGE 10 cm 2024 (in leaf). Ground photos (Wikimedia Commons, in the research folder under showcase/imagery/hirschengraben/photos/): commons_Bern_Hirschengraben_2024.jpg (21 January 2024, looking south from the north tip), commons_Hotel_National_in_Bern.jpg (30 April 2022).
